title: One of Suno's latest investors will be of particular interest to the music industry (Music Business Worldwide)
notes: MBW, Daniel Tencer, 2025-11-24. Hallwood Media (founded 2020 by Neil Jacobson, ex-UMG Geffen President) participated in Suno's $250M Series C. HMV led by Todd Lowen + Neil Jacobson. Hallwood 'all in on AI music'; signed Imoliver + Xania Monet (Telisha Jones). Supports Q2/Q3.
